en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street lined with multi‑storey historic houses on the left and a tree‑filled park or promenade on the right. In the park a tall, narrow monument or column (a war memorial) rises above the trees. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Red printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and publisher.
